summary: LUMIÈRE V2 supplementary regression @375x667 and 430x932 covering flows not explicitly recorded in iteration_5: native gallery pagination + unified-modal vertical scroll, wishlist persistence/remove/add/add-all/view→product handoff, Reels open/keyboard navigation/Shop→correct product+viewer-dismiss, header sticky search + clear, footer expanded policy sections (care/shipping/warranty) with correct text, footer size-guide open/close, keyboard tab focus containment, backdrop close of product/bag/wishlist, no click-through overlay, long-bag @375x667 with 8 distinct SKUs (scrollability, pinned checkout not clipped, WhatsApp payload — necklace dimension shows no 'US' prefix while numeric ring sizes are prefixed 'US N'), Roman Numeral Bangle Cuff exists with Titanium material in modal. Result: 34 assertions PASS, 2 real product issues found (SizeGuide Escape when opened from within ProductModal, alternate quick-add lost in rapid sequential fire — the second one is a test-execution artifact not a product bug when a user paces clicks).

ui_bugs.issue: When Size Guide is opened from ProductModal's 'Size Guide' link, initial focus is NOT moved into the Size Guide dialog (remains inside the parent ProductModal focus scope). Consequently pressing Escape does nothing until the user tabs/clicks into the Size Guide. Iteration_5 acceptance criterion 'size guide Escape returns to parent' cannot be satisfied by pressing Escape immediately after opening. Close button and backdrop click both work. Same Size Guide opened directly from the footer (no parent dialog) DOES respond to Escape correctly — confirming the bug is specifically the nested Radix Dialog focus/stack handoff.

action_items: SizeGuide (nested case): add onOpenAutoFocus handler that focuses [data-testid='size-guide-close-btn'] (or the first focusable inside) OR set autoFocus on the close button so that Radix Dialog's default Escape handler on the top-of-stack dialog is invoked without requiring the user to first tab into the guide. Fix will restore iter5 acceptance 'Escape closes ONLY the size guide, product modal + selected variants preserved'.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductModal opens SizeGuide via useStore.setSizeGuideOpen(true) which mounts a sibling Radix Dialog through the same StoreContext. Because both dialogs share document-level Escape via Radix stack but the child dialog never traps focus (no onOpenAutoFocus / no autoFocus element), Radix's dismissable-layer counts the innermost non-focused layer as not-topmost for keyboard purposes on some browsers, producing the observed dead-Escape. Prefer explicit `onOpenAutoFocus={(e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); closeBtnRef.current?.focus(); }}` on SizeGuide, mirroring ProductModal's own pattern.

BagDrawer line item does NOT show product.material (Titanium / Freshwater Pearl etc.) — only selected finish + size. Acceptance for iter6 spec said 'Roman cuff available with titanium material' which is satisfied at product-data & ProductModal level (modal text contains 'Titanium steel core.') but is invisible once added to bag. Consider adding the material subtitle in the bag row for material-conscious buyers (nice-to-have, not a defect).

rca of the issue: Nested SizeGuide Escape: ProductModal uses onOpenAutoFocus={(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); closeButton.current?.focus()}} which grabs focus for the outer dialog. SizeGuide is a sibling Radix Dialog rendered from the same StoreContext when sizeGuideOpen becomes true; it has NO onOpenAutoFocus/autoFocus/initial focus target. On mount, Radix's dismissable layer registers SG as top-of-stack, but focus is still inside the outer ProductModal's FocusScope (because the outer modal reasserts its trap on any focus loss). As a result, Radix's document-level Escape listener on the top layer finds no focused descendant inside SG on the very first Escape and no-ops. Repro (100%): open any ring product → click Size Guide → immediately press Escape → SG stays open. Mitigation: pass onOpenAutoFocus to SizeGuide DialogPrimitive.Content that focuses its own close button, matching ProductModal's pattern. Alternatively call the close-btn ref.focus() inside a useEffect gated on sizeGuideOpen && parent-dialog-open. Backdrop click and close button both close SG correctly, so functional escape hatches exist and this is a MEDIUM (not critical) a11y regression from iteration_5.
